messages:
alina: Need to finalize Q4 scope for multi-region tenant isolation. Sales wants clear SKUs and launch gates.

sanjay: Propose three modes: affinity, soft-slice (evictable), reserved slice (SLA). List tradeoffs and launch criteria.

mike: Ops: soft-slice requires eviction audit + graceful drains; reserved needs capacity planning + billing metering.

jen: Gate for pilot: routing DSL v1, eviction telemetry, canary rollout, perf baseline at 8k RPS.

tara: Finance: reserved slices could raise unit costs ~15%. Need fragmentation sims.

ops-bot: Note: tenant-eviction alerts now escalate at >5/min for 10m.

sanjay: Action: mike -> cost model (Tue), jen -> sample SLA text (Thu), alina -> Sales sync Wed 10am.
